item.description:
A pause is not a full stop. An afterthought after a breath used to land as a sentence of its own: "I need to submit the return. For both companies." It now joins the sentence it belongs to. The same holds between presses: start the next one within 45 seconds with words that carry on the last sentence, such as "for both companies", "which…" or "or the other one", and they take back its full stop and continue in lowercase. Ctrl+Alt+Backspace still deletes what you just said, and puts the stop back. Real new sentences, "And I call the broker." among them, stay sentences.

Prompt falls back to Draft. When Prompt has to set its rewrite aside, Draft now stands in before Clean, and the overlay says "Draft instead" for a moment. Prompt keeps your final full stop. Fewer rewrites are set aside for harmless changes, such as "yes" for "yeah" or a request turned from a question into an instruction.

Missed a release? 0.19.0 let you carry on a sentence by deleting its full stop and dictating again, kept a word said in full in full in Draft, made Draft and Prompt about a fifth faster, joined spoken "dash", "underscore" and "dot" where a file name is meant, and added the Statistics window. 0.18.2 read a full stop before "which" or "because" as the pause it was, and applied your dictionary before the model sees the text. 0.18.1 fixed a blank words-per-minute figure for anyone with Record dictations off. Every release, in order: github.com/romeo-golf-software/dictation-releases/releases.
